title: Design System: Luna Bites & Delights — Storefront

display.purpose: Wordmark, section heads, prices, plate labels, tags.

label.purpose: Uppercase Karla with wide tracking for nav, plates, meta rows.

components.name: Sale plate
components.description: The painted button: every order action, map action and page message.
components.css: .plate { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.55em; background:#a3301a; color:#fff6e9; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(.82rem,1.1vw,.95rem); letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; padding:1.1em 1.7em; box-shadow:0 .32em 0 #8a2a18, 0 1.4em 2.2em -1.2em rgba(0,0,0,.9); transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1), box-shadow .18s ease; } .plate:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 .44em 0 #8a2a18, 0 1.6em 2.4em -1.2em rgba(0,0,0,.95); } .plate:active { transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow:0 .1em 0 #8a2a18, 0 .8em 1.4em -1em rgba(0,0,0,.9); } .plate--invert { background:#f7eedd; color:#0f0906; box-shadow:0 .3em 0 rgba(15,9,6,.3), 0 1.4em 2.2em -1.2em rgba(0,0,0,.9); }

components.name: Fare rail
components.description: Signature instrument: distance in km to the fare in pesos, driven by pointer or keyboard.
components.html: 3 KM
components.css: .rail { position:relative; height:52px; cursor:ew-resize; touch-action:none; } .rail:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e0c9a6; outline-offset:5px; } .rail__needle { position:absolute; top:0; left:calc((var(--v) - 1) / 11 * 100%); transform:translateX(-50%); background:#d8452a; box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.55); transition:left .5s cubic-bezier(.3,1.24,.42,1); } .rail.is-dragging .rail__needle { transition:left .1s linear; } .rail__tag { background:#2c2016; color:#f7eedd; padding:.28em .42em; } .rail__ticks { position:absolute; inset:auto 0 0; }

components.name: Offer card
components.description: ₱99 bundles: painted price plate, tag, dish list.
components.css: .offer { background:#2c2016; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06); padding:clamp(18px,2.4vw,26px); } .offer__price { justify-self:start; padding:0 .22em .06em; background:#a3301a; color:#f7eedd; font-family:var(--display); font-weight:900; font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3rem); line-height:.92; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Photo mount
components.description: A print taped to the wall: paper border, slight rotation, painted price tag.
components.css: .mount { position:relative; transform:rotate(-1.2deg); } .mount img { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; border:6px solid #f7eedd; box-shadow:0 22px 34px -22px #000, 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05); object-fit:cover; } .tag { position:absolute; right:-10px; bottom:12px; transform:rotate(2.2deg); background:#a3301a; color:#f7eedd; font-family:var(--display); font-weight:700; font-size:1.02rem; padding:.34em .55em; }

components.name: Price row
components.description: Dish, dotted leader, tabular price — the menu board's unit.
components.css: .row { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.5em; padding:.52em 0; border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(224,201,166,.22); } .row__name { font-family:var(--display); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(1.18rem,1.7vw,1.45rem); line-height:1.1; letter-spacing:.012em; color:#f6ecd9; } .row__dots { flex:1; border-bottom:1px dotted rgba(224,201,166,.28); transform:translateY(-.2em); } .row__price { font-size:clamp(1.05rem,1.5vw,1.25rem); font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:#e0c9a6; } .row--promo .row__price { color:#ffb9a4; }

narrative.overview: The storefront is painted like the front of a jeepney. Dark enamel ground, chrome rules on every edge, fares lettered where a passenger reads them. It is one page at / that hands you to a Flutter kiosk at /kiosk/ — the ordering flow is never re-drawn here. Bright vermilion is a state, not a surface; type-bearing surfaces are the deeper painted red so cream clears 4.5:1. Big Shoulders does the shouting, Karla does the talking.
keyCharacteristics: Enamel ground with chrome rules; no glass, no blur, no glow
One bright vermilion for live state only; painted plates carry the type
Square corners, hard offset lips, painted depth
The fare rail is a working instrument (pointer + keyboard + ARIA), not a graphic
Real photos from the business, rotated like prints on a wall
Nothing invented: no hours, no phone number, no ratings

rules.name: The One Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Bright vermilion #d8452a is a live state. Any rectangle carrying type is #a3301a, #8a2a18 or cream.

rules.name: The Enamel Ground Rule
rules.body: One vertical gradient from #2b1e14 to #20160d. Depth comes from panels and plates, never from coloured glows or radial halos.

rules.name: The Signage-and-Speech Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders never sets a paragraph; Karla never sets a price.

rules.name: The Wide-Label Rule
rules.body: Functional labels are uppercase Karla at 0.16em tracking or wider, minimum 0.72rem.

rules.name: The Painted Lip Rule
rules.body: Every raised surface gets a hard lip in a darker red plus one soft black cast. No coloured glow, no zero-offset halo, no backdrop blur.

dos: Do paint every type-bearing surface in --verm-plate and keep cream on it (6.55:1).
Do set functional labels at 11.5px or larger, uppercase Karla, wide tracking.
Do give raised surfaces a hard lip plus one soft black cast, lifting 2px on hover.
Do keep the fare rail's ticks and labels outside the slider element.
Do rotate photo mounts 1–2° and pin a painted tag on them.
Do end with one full-bleed vermilion band and one cream plate.
donts: Don't add coloured glows, zero-offset halos, or radial background washes.
Don't use coloured left-border tabs on cards, glyph icons, or a second accent hue.
Don't round corners, use backdrop-filter, or draw depth with blur alone.
Don't invent business facts — hours, phone numbers, ratings, testimonials.
Don't duplicate the ordering flow; every order action links to /kiosk/.
